title: Fractionalize RWAs into Native Tokens on Cardano (open source, no-code solution)

ms.promise: Completion of written requirements for (i) the user interface features, flows, and user experience, and (ii) smart contract functionality and configuration.
ms.criteria:
Requirements must clearly and completely encompass the full range of the user experience, with examples of key workflows from beginning to end across at least 3 use cases. 
Key workflows include: 
・Vault formation: Vaults are user-configurable smart contracts ("SC") that allow users to send on-chain assets (NFTs, FTs) to the SC, to be locked until certain criteria are met, or until the transaction is cancelled. Users who establish the Vault SCs are the "Admin" users of each vault. 
・Fractionalization: The process by which 3rd party users will send ADA to the SC and receive newly minted fractio
ms.report:
Based on your feedback, we have updated the format of requirements to be publicly listed from our Github page. 
Please find the requirements at the following links.
・Completion of written requirements for (i) the user interface features, flows, and user experience: https://github.com/L4VA-Technologies-Inc/reqs/wiki/Frontend-Requirements
・Completion of written requirements for (ii) smart contract functionality and configuration
・Vault Formation Guidelines: https://github.com/L4VA-Technologies-Inc/reqs/wiki/Vault-Formation
・API Introductions & Standards: https://github.com/L4VA-Technologies-Inc/reqs/wiki/api_intro

In addition we are documenting requirements and best practices for the entire application across this bookstack page at https://docs.l4va.com for your reference.

ms.promise: Completed smart contract code, commit of smart contracts and integration into the front end, launching of the test-net in Beta publicly to the community.
ms.criteria: Smart contracts must be able to successfully complete transactions using all variations of configurations in pre-prod, then must be tested successfully by the community in test-net beta phase with over 25 contracts being created and over 100 transactions successfully completing. By completing 100 transactions in the smart contracts, showing tADA being sent to the SC address and receiving the test fungible tokens minted as a result of the smart contracts executing, and providing links to the transaction logs, this will demonstrate that successful operation of the smart contracts.
ms.report:
